title: Only One of Four Was Intact
text:
Only One of Four Was Intact. Shipping package was not damaged. As you can see the product package was fine but lacked ANY padding, the glasses weren't wrapped or protected in any way. I'm surprised one arrived unbroken.
The shot glasses are a unique design and would have been a standout on poker or gaming night. But I opted for a refund with packaging this poor there's no sense in replacements.
Very disappointed.
